fixes.fix: Top-down distinctness (the colony camera looks down): shuttle, medical, science, trader and liner share one capsule plan with two engines (fleet_top.png; art/critic/r11_top_gamedist.png at 25%). Shuttle is the weakest: from the top it is a plain white capsule. Paint the shuttle roof graphite with the yellow stripe crossing it, and give it a raised passenger deck (a 0.6 m step along the rear two thirds) so its plan and roof differ.

Liner: make it the dart the table asks for: a 2.5 m tapered nose cone instead of the shared bridge block, a narrower plan (0.8 x the trader width), swept fins visible from the top, and the pink band running along the roof spine so it shows from above.

Bridges: all six carry the same faceted bridge block, so at night six identical yellow windscreens are the brightest thing on each ship (r11_night.png). Keep the frame language but vary the cockpit: shuttle a tall flat bus windscreen, liner a wraparound panoramic band, courier a canopy, medical and science the current block, trader the current block.

Night windows are flat saturated yellow at full strength and read as stickers. Use a warm #FFD9A0, emissive about 60% of now, with the mullions dark, and let passenger windows (shuttle, liner) be dimmer than the bridge.
Show the belly floods and the ramp at night: one night render per ship from the ramp side.
Trader ramp: it still comes down between the two engine bells. Move it to one side of the tail (as on the shuttle and liner, which use side ramps).
Flight renders: the ships hover off the pad centre and the shuttle and science ship intersect the kiosk (r11_flight.png). Render the flight pose centred over the pad.

Family with the colony: the hulls are smooth capsules; the Meridian and rooms use flat panels and hard edges. Add 2-3 flat panel insets per flank on shuttle, medical and science (the trader has them) so the fleet matches the colony detail density.

what_works: One fleet: shared legs, engines, bridge frames, rails, hazard frames, registration codes and palette; they sit well with the colony whites and graphite.

From the side at game distance each ship has one dominant colour (orange, graphite, pink, red cross, blue, black-gold) and one cue (pods, window rows, fins, cross, dish mast, wedge) (fleet_lineup.png).
Night: bridges, nav lights and liner fin lights make every ship findable (r11_night.png).

notes: Still the old pad. The kiosk stands 1-2 m from the nose of every ship at the render yaw (r11_pad.png) and the ramps of the shuttle and liner land beside it; place the kiosk outside every ship's footprint + ramp lane (use the largest: trader radius and liner length).
The pink edge-light dots repeat the liner's pink; use amber or white edge lights as asked in round 9.
